referenceFunction.generalComment: Material consumption values refer to the production of one average lorry in the referring weight class (net weight 11000). Total Kilometric performance: 1E06. Interventions for manufacturing processes of vehicles are independent of weight class.; UUID: 5a19e7b9-90cf-3a08-ae31-bc812311f534
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes processes of material, energy and water use in vehicle manufacturing (final assembly, engine production and manufacturing of metal parts). Rail and road transport of materials is accounted for. Plant infrastructure is included, addressing issues such as land use, building, road and parking construction.
referenceFunction.name: Bus

geography.text: Vehicle manufacturing data are taken from one production site in Germany.

technology.text: Current production technology, environmental issues have been addressed in the past.

timePeriod.text: The material consumption represents a current low-entry bus vehicle (Volvo 8500 low entry; 12 l engine). The data for vehicle production are representative for lorry/bus production of one German company with an environmental management system. The data includes the final assembly (2000), engine production (2002) and the manufacturing of metal parts (2002).

representativeness.extrapolations: Data from one production site in Germany is used as an first estimate for Europe
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Manufacturing data is taken from an environmental report of one production site. Additional data was generated via oral communcation.
